clips.title: The story
paras: The Simple Letter is an introductory directive that guides novice warriors to trainer Llane Beshere at Northshire Abbey. It marks the beginning of their formal martial instruction and urges them to assist the troubled citizens of the valley.

The Simple Letter serves as an initial introduction for aspiring warriors arriving in Northshire Valley. Directed to Llane Beshere, the resident warrior trainer at Northshire Abbey, the letter prompts newly arrived fighters to make contact with their instructor, familiarize themselves with their surroundings, and prepare for the demands of martial life.

Although Northshire Abbey enjoys protection under the watchful presence of the Knights of the Silver Hand, the peaceful facade of the valley belies deeper trouble. As Beshere notes upon receiving the letter, the surrounding residents face numerous plights that require able-bodied protectors, urging fresh recruits to master their weapons and step forward in defense of the realm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, friend. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Llane, our local adventurer trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, you got my letter, friend... Good.
There's been an influx of adventurers in Elwynn recently--which is good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and Defias in the area.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Get yourself squared away, learn the layout of the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

The Knights of the Silver Hand have done well in making this place fairly safe, but as you meet the other citizens, I think you'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help an adventurer can give them. Good luck.
